review_authorization: Root read the frozen contracts/source reviews, accepted exact statement and source bindings and their limits, and authorized scoped integration. Actual integration checks are recorded separately.

kcache_copy_triton: Root accepted the independent four-module/source/receipt review and exact final source hashes. Ordered logical host preparation retains both cache layouts, 3D/4D keys, Torch-style reshape view-stride inference or snapshot copy, natural n including zero and n>1, all original stride arguments, errors and 3D grid. Every actual program reads prior actual memory; the independent reference advances prior reference memory and retains aliases and full frame. Materialized reshape preserves every 4D strided value; successful view-stride address preservation is still unproved. Six logical floating constructors include opaque legacy fp64, while only five raw machine formats were previously closed; nine discrete profiles share logical integer carriers. Lengths/tables always read signed Int and have no independent dtype arguments. Original ignored strides/unchecked shapes remain explicit. The 36 CPU cases and 35 Lean metadata checks do not establish universal native/source refinement. No numerical callback law or successful-execution/no-alias premise is introduced.
lora_expand_gemv: Root accepted the independent five-module/source/receipt review. Ordered logical dtype, shape, contiguity, squeeze and stride processing retains exact N/K/configuration and source-derived BLOCK_K/EVEN_K/CAST_TYPE/ADD_INPUTS. Fixed six-shift next_power_of_2 matches the inspected helper; K=0 rejects before launch and N=0 produces an empty logical grid without certifying native legality. Every original (N,batches) program executes the complete source on prior actual memory, with independent reference/frame and aliases retained. The 576 CPU metadata combinations plus 14 ordered errors are source probes, not GPU or Lean cross-evaluation. All six asserted input/weight pairs combine with three explicit output profiles; unchecked output/index dtype coverage is incomplete and index loads always use mathematical signed Int. Host model is separately reviewed, not admitted as Python by the shared Triton DSL. Native tensor/ABI/allocation/address/launch/concurrency obligations remain structural. Existing numerical bindings remain explicit follow-up work.
fp4_to_bf16: Root accepted independent review of both frozen modules and the actual source/dependency hashes. Each scheduled program executes the complete inherited BLOCK=512 source with fresh registers and prior actual memory. A derived exact write set and preserved packed input make an independent membership-based initial-byte reference valid for arbitrary partial schedules, repeats and inactive extra IDs. The public contract restricts jobs to permutations of the complete original grid and gives exact full Host.expectedMemory and frame. It assumes only the inherited PackedInput, fresh logical output and permutation premises; no execution/result or numerical law is assumed. This closes arbitrary sequential whole-program order for that profile, not native instruction interleavings, physical aliases/allocation or unrestricted Python caller/dtype/error domains.

original_scope.covered: Complete ordered logical wrapper and successful actual sequential execution of every grid program, or ordered host rejection before launch. The final independent memory and global frame retain inter-program aliases and changed indices.
remaining_structural_obligations: Unrestricted output/index dtype domain is not closed: output is explicitly bound to fp16/bf16/fp32, and indices use the inherited mathematical signed-cell model. The original Python wrapper has no output/index dtype assertion.

Logical natural tensor metadata, contiguous checks, squeeze and region data pointers need native tensor/byte-memory/allocation correspondence. Source Python-to-logical-model equivalence is reviewed/probed, not a verified Python compiler theorem.

Fixed-width integer arithmetic, intermediate overflow, negative active indices, native pointer/address legality and allocated bounds remain open. The total interpreter uses Nat/Int element offsets and may clamp negative pointer offsets.

Native block/arange/resource legality and JIT/launch admission remain open, including zero-N SPLIT_N=0 and empty grids. The installed six-shift next_power_of_2 is modeled exactly, without asserting an ideal unbounded power-of-two property.
One explicit pid0-fastest sequential traversal is proved. Native GPU cross-program scheduling, read/write races, byte aliases and schedule independence remain unproved.

Unmodeled caller features such as arbitrary tensor/device kinds and Python argument types remain outside the logical descriptors. The inference-mode decorator and full Python runtime/exception behavior have no formal correspondence here.

Output/index metadata acceptance is broader than execution dtype semantics. Native index-width/format binding and physically aliased byte reinterpretations cannot be inferred from abstract signed-cell reads.
remaining_native_numerical_bindings: Bind native FP configuration, rounding/FTZ/special values and low-precision operations to the software operations.
Bind compiled reduction tree, seeds, fusion and reassociation to the supplied valid ReductionPlan.
Bind native conversion details, including fp16/bf16 cross-conversion via fp32 and NaN/signed-zero behavior.
